snippet.title: Farmbotic gameplay and name change trailer - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
Farmatic has officially changed its name to Farmbotic, which has a much nicer ring to it. This cozy farming simulator launches next year with full crossplay.
